description: Intelligent Agriculture Labs is a small team working where space data meets the farm gate. Satellites watch every field on Earth, but very little of that knowledge reaches the people who farm them. We close that gap by turning NASA's open data into short, trustworthy cards that say what's changing on your field, why it matters and what to do next. You can tap any card to see the evidence behind it. We design for real conditions: weak connectivity, many languages and decisions that can't wait.
